items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Wins FDA Breakthrough Tag For Olomorasib, Backs $70 Million Raise
items.summary: The FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy designation to Eli Lilly's olomorasib as a monotherapy for KRAS G12C-mutant advanced pancreatic cancer. This is the second Breakthrough Therapy designation for olomorasib, which targets a patient group with limited treatment options. Ratio Therapeutics raised US$70 million in a Series C round that included participation from Eli Lilly.
